events.title: Pre-Release Update: Performance, Controller, and UI Polish
events.summary: We’ve locked the final planned Windows 1.0 revision ahead of Idle Necronomics’ October 27 release. Performance Improved performance during busy late-game combat, especially when large numbers of damage indicators are appearing. Reduced frame stalls by reusing the capped damage-number presentation and reducing combat-time allocations. Optimized wound setup and background Soul Crystal status and save work. events.title: Demo Update 0.28.2 — Clearer Decisions, Cleaner Campaign
events.summary: Today's free Demo update brings its interface in line with the latest production build of Idle Necronomics. Clearer Campaign decisions The Campaign screen now separates the current run, next boss, active power, permanent progress, and run profile into distinct cards. Achievement cards also have dedicated space for their title, requirement, current value, and progress gauge, making long-term goals much easier to scan. events.title: # Demo Update 0.22.2 — A Faster Start and Visible Soul Reaping
events.summary: Today's free Demo update sharpens the opening minutes of Idle Necronomics. You can now begin reaping immediately from the title screen. New Demo players enter the campaign directly, while returning players can continue their current run without an extra save-selection step. The most visible change happens on every kill: Souls now rise from the defeated body and travel into the Soul Vessel.
